name: ai.getfacade/mcp
title: GetFacade
description: Designs a real house exterior on its own photo, prices it line by line and documents it.

environmentVariables.name: GETFACADE_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Agent key issued at app.getfacade.ai under Account, Settings, API. Shown once.

environmentVariables.name: GETFACADE_API_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the API. Leave unset to use the production one.

environmentVariables.name: GETFACADE_LANG
environmentVariables.description: Language the service answers and refuses in. Leave unset for English.
